concepts.short: A Transformer encoder that allows each token to attend to both left and right context in all layers, unlike unidirectional models like OpenAI GPT.
A pre-training objective where 15% of input tokens are randomly masked and the model must predict them using full bidirectional context.
A binary pre-training task where the model predicts whether sentence B follows sentence A, teaching sentence-level relationships.
The process of taking a pre-trained BERT model and training all its parameters on a downstream task with a small task-specific output layer.
Training BERT on large unlabeled text corpora using MLM and NSP objectives to learn general language representations.
The core mechanism in Transformers that computes weighted representations of all tokens in a sequence, enabling bidirectional context fusion.
A special token prepended to every input sequence; its final hidden state is used as the aggregate representation for classification tasks.
A special separator token used to delimit two sentences in a single input sequence, e.g., question and passage.
A subword tokenization method that splits rare words into smaller units, with a 30,000 token vocabulary used by BERT.
A collection of nine natural language understanding tasks used to evaluate models like BERT; BERT achieved state-of-the-art scores on it.
